InteractionGuardOptions.name: InteractionGuardOptions
InteractionGuardOptions.doc:
Subset of InteractionGuard props that can be customized by consumers.
Excludes internal props like scopeId, asChild, and children.

props.name: scopeAttr
props.description: Attribute used to mark the scope root on the wrapped content

props.name: disableOutsidePointerEvents
props.description:
When `true`, hover/focus/click interactions will be disabled on elements outside
the guard. Users will need to click twice on outside elements to interact with them:
once to close, and again to trigger the element.

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Event handler called when the escape key is down. Can be prevented via event.preventDefault().

props.name: onPointerDownOutside
props.description: Called when a pointerdown happens outside. Can be prevented on the synthetic event below.

props.name: onFocusOutside
props.description: Called when focus moves outside. Can be prevented on the synthetic event below.

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: Called when either a pointerdown outside or a focus outside occurs. Can be prevented.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the layer should be dismissed (e.g., on Escape or outside interactions not prevented).

props.name: surfaceSelector
props.description: Selector to determine "inside" surfaces (e.g., [data-menu-surface])

props.name: branchAttr
props.description:
Optional attribute used by Branch to whitelist additional areas as "inside".
Defaults to data-interaction-branch.

props.name: scopeId
props.description: Unique scope ID for this menu instance

props.name: closeAllSurfaces
props.description: Close all surfaces (root + submenus) in depth order

props.name: registerSurface
props.description: Register a surface with its depth (0 = root, 1+ = submenus)

props.name: unregisterSurface
props.description: Unregister a surface when it unmounts

props.name: interactionGuardOptions
props.description: InteractionGuard options for the root menu

props.name: defaults
props.description: Base defaults (factory + instance) shared across the entire menu
